records.name: Angular UCarousel
records.purpose: Paged horizontal or vertical template-driven collection carousel with navigation and timed advancement.
records.surface: Generic UCarousel<T=unknown>; inputs value:T[]=[], numVisible=1, numScroll=1, circular=false, showIndicators=true, showNavigators=true, autoplayInterval=0, orientation:"horizontal"|"vertical"="horizontal". Output onPage:UCarouselPageEvent with page:number. Exported UCarouselItemContext<T> has $implicit:T for the @ContentChild("item", {descendants:false}) TemplateRef; each item uses ngTemplateOutlet with that context, with no default textual item renderer. Public navForward(), navBackward() and goToPage(index:number) update the internal page and emit onPage; previous/next wrap only when circular. totalPages is 0 for an empty collection and ceil((value.length-numVisible)/numScroll)+1 otherwise; the translate percentage is page*numScroll*100/numVisible, on X or Y according to orientation. Native navigator and indicator buttons have labels; the content wrapper has aria-live=polite when autoplayInterval>0 and off otherwise. Autoplay starts in ngOnInit when the interval is positive, always wraps at the last page, and is stopped by previous/next navigation and on destroy; indicator navigation does not stop it. Owned source-only carouselStyleModule exports css/classes, and source-only CarouselItemListParams has optional numVisible:number and vertical:boolean for class calculation. Selector u-carousel; standalone OnPush component with ViewEncapsulation.None, componentName "carousel", extends UBaseComponent (inherited dt and unstyled inputs; ngOnInit registers theme variables). Style adapter is imported locally, not barrel-exported, and does not import @ultimate/uix-styles. Aura preset components registers carousel: carousel; no scoped record is registered in packages/component-metadata/src/index.ts.

records.name: Angular UImage
records.purpose: Image with optional preview overlay, rotation and zoom controls.
records.surface: UImage inputs src?:string, alt?:string, width?:string, height?:string, preview=false. Outputs onShow:void, onHide:void, onImageError:Event. No projected content or public template override. A plain img binds src/alt/width/height and error; preview adds a native Zoom image button, then an @if mask with UOverlay appendTo="body", dialog aria-modal, UFocusTrap toolbar, rotate-right/left, zoom-out/in and UTimesIcon close controls. Preview img reuses src without an alt binding. Protected rotate methods adjust 90 degrees; scale starts at 1 with step 0.1, min 0.5 and max 1.5; disabled comparisons test the next value <=min or >=max, so boundary values are not reached through these buttons. Mask click, local Escape or the shared escapeRegistry/displayOrderRegistry at ESCAPE_PRIORITIES.IMAGE close the preview, reset rotate/scale and emit onHide; opening emits onShow and queues close-button focus. records.name: Angular USplitter
records.purpose: Resizable template-based panels with per-panel minimums and pointer/keyboard gutters.
records.surface: USplitter inputs layout:"horizontal"|"vertical"="horizontal", gutterSize=4 and step=5. Outputs onResizeStart and onResizeEnd:USplitterResizeEvent, an exported interface {originalEvent:Event;sizes:number[]}. Exported standalone USplitterPanel directive selects ng-template[uSplitterPanel], exposes readonly templateRef:TemplateRef and minSize=0 aliased uSplitterPanelMinSize (numberAttribute). @ContentChildren(USplitterPanel) yields panel templates rendered with ngTemplateOutlet; ngAfterContentInit seeds equal percentage sizes. Each panel flex-basis is calc(size% - gutterCount*gutterSize px). Gutters use role=separator and focusable handles with aria-orientation/aria-valuenow. Mouse/touch start/move/end chains resize adjacent panels using pointer deltas and clamp against per-panel minimums. ArrowLeft/Right decrement/increment in horizontal layout; ArrowDown/Up decrement/increment in vertical layout. Keyboard resizing performs an immediate step then setInterval at 40 ms; keyup clears it and emits the end event. DestroyRef registers mouse-listener cleanup only; touch listeners and the repeat timer are cleared on their corresponding interaction-end paths rather than that destroy callback. Owned source-only splitterStyleModule exports css/classes. Selector u-splitter; standalone OnPush component with ViewEncapsulation.None, componentName "splitter", extends UBaseComponent (inherited dt and unstyled inputs; ngOnInit registers theme variables). Style adapter is imported locally, not barrel-exported, and does not import @ultimate/uix-styles. records.name: Angular UScrollPanel
records.purpose: Scrollable content container with custom draggable and keyboard-operated scrollbar thumbs.
records.surface: UScrollPanel input step=5; no outputs. Default ng-content in a native scrolling div with hidden native scrollbars; horizontal and vertical focusable role=scrollbar thumbs mirror content position and visible/total ratios with requestAnimationFrame and a 10% minimum thumb size. Public scrollTop(scrollTop:number):void clamps the offset and refresh():void recalculates thumbs. Mouse document listeners drag the chosen axis; focus and last changed scroll axis select arrow-key orientation. setTimer uses one setTimeout at 40 ms per keydown, cleared on keyup, rather than a self-rescheduling repeat loop. Browser-only ngAfterViewInit measures and installs resize handling; DestroyRef removes resize/mouse listeners and cancels frame/timer; ngOnDestroy also removes listeners. uuid generates contentId bound by both thumbs' aria-controls, but the content div has no matching id binding. Owned source-only scrollPanelStyleModule exports css/classes; focus CSS requests scrollpanel.barfocus.ring.width/offset alongside scrollpanel.bar.focus.ring.* tokens.
